lanes.title: Exclusive global manifests, bundle and release integrator

tasks.title: Recheck source checkpoint, scope and live owners
actions: Compare current sources with the planning checkpoint; record caller/export/platform inventory template and untouched compiler/producer boundaries. Reconcile proposed responsibility layout with the living filetree before implementation, without implementing or advancing a checkpoint during planning.
acceptance: Existing packages-only functionality, source changes, baseline failures and coverage limits have owners; scope remains revisable with evidence.

tasks.title: Assign exclusive resources and dispatch capacity
actions: Assign a single writer per logical lane and shared integration file; publish A/V binding and W/V runtime handoffs. Choose three implementation workers plus one coordinator by default; maintain ready and blocked queues.
acceptance: No two active tasks write one shared file/lane; workers consume ready backlog and blockers name an owner and exit condition.

tasks.title: Common scope and ownership ready
actions: Review cited raw evidence before releasing the gate.
acceptance: Package inventories can proceed; this is the common readiness gate, not completion of A01/V01/W01/P01.

tasks.title: Publish prepared-boundary and observable-trace method
actions: Agree current versus prepared TS comparisons, fixture attribution and extraction review rules. Preserve different error/presence/clone/auth/evaluation policies; do not rewrite exact arithmetic merely for a baseline.
acceptance: Each plan can extract independently; matching source traces and full consumer evidence are explicit acceptance, not assumed from common scaffolding.

tasks.title: Prepared-boundary method ready
actions: Review cited raw evidence before releasing the gate.
acceptance: A02/V02/W02/P02 contribute their own prepared evidence later.

tasks.title: Freeze minimal versioned transport and profile handoffs
actions: Freeze explicit presence, f64/raw BigInt, UTF-16 key/string order, result/error envelopes, corruption and lifetime rules. Keep values/work/native payloads separately owned; no generic universal serializer/validator.
acceptance: Minimal smoke contracts and pinning/toolchain choices are executable; scalar semantics remain values-owned, catalogs/declarations producer-owned.

tasks.title: Build encoder/decoder vectors and pinning spike
actions: Test scalar/text/presence/version/length vectors and native/binding build choices against actual installed APIs and licenses/support. Timebox the minimal proof, recording a reproducible chosen route or bounded alternative.
acceptance: Bad versions/lengths are rejected; no latest-version example is accepted without actual build evidence; common proof does not require full semantic modules.

tasks.title: Minimal ABI and pinning contracts ready
actions: Review cited raw evidence before releasing the gate.
acceptance: Subsystem native foundations may begin; full binding/protocol conformance joins C03.complete.

tasks.title: Land typed text/binary asset contract and host plumbing
actions: Implement the agreed typed inventory, safe byte writing/propagation and pinned installed module type mapping; leave source rewriting/maps on text. Keep v1 text-only output byte-identical and version mixed digests/manifests.
acceptance: Binary lengths/hashes are exact; CompiledWasm is verified against the installed API; text-only hash/order/serialization fixtures pass.

tasks.title: Build tiny actual binding and smoke fixture
actions: Build one pinned precompiled binding, synchronous startup/call and failure vector. Keep this fixture independent of work package graph and all arithmetic/validation implementations.
acceptance: Native/Node/Bun glue startup and synchronous entry actually execute; missing/corrupt/wrong-ABI module fails, no semantic fallback.

tasks.title: Prove actual local workerd and deployment-map loader
actions: Run the real generated tiny binding through this repository built deployment map and local workerd/testkit propagation; record exact asset/import/bootstrap path.
acceptance: No fake Wasm replies/text markers; one initialized instance, malformed bytes/startup failures and text-only legacy parity pass.

tasks.title: Tiny actual loader and typed asset proof ready
actions: Review cited raw evidence before releasing the gate.
acceptance: Runtime plans may verify their own generated bindings next. This gate does not certify actual values/work assets, final vendor maps or installed consumers. Native JS-only preparation is independent of this Wasm proof.

tasks.title: Land root and consumer dependency/build graph
actions: Use the minimal emitted work-kernel contract to install acyclic runtime dependencies, explicit build order, exports and release commands. Apply other agreed common build hooks; package-local values/work/native manifests retain their designated owners.
acceptance: Root/consumer build and lockfile graph is executable, no state→full-work cycle, and no compiler Cargo workspace is introduced. This gate does not certify final work assets.

tasks.title: Fulfil actual values binding and vendor inventory
actions: Integrate actual generated values glue/binary imports, vendor entry, shipped dist roots and release inventory using the frozen asset paths. Full arithmetic/validation rebuilds must continue to use those paths and validate final bytes in their own gates.
acceptance: Values consumers use actual shipped assets, not the smoke fixture; native binary is excluded from Worker maps; missing/corrupt/version errors fail visibly.

tasks.title: Fulfil work generated asset and package request
actions: Apply W05.2 exact vendor/bare-import/binary/integrity/dist-root request, using real W05.1 outputs and the owning release stamp. Return reviewed source/asset hashes and completed integration evidence to work verification.
acceptance: Actual work binary and package are in built runtime/deploy/testkit inventory; W05.4/W05.3 certify installed package and workerd afterward.

tasks.title: Land native bundle-helper integration
actions: Apply the exact P05.2 coarse stage/export request around the typed asset contract. Keep Bun and catalog derivation with their existing producer; preserve worker-missing fallback and all failure order.
acceptance: P05 host/native lanes receive reviewed exports/source hash; no duplicated catalog or arbitrary asset format; initial JS-only native consumer does not wait for C04.ready.

tasks.title: Land native command, stamp and dist inventory
actions: Integrate native package-local build/package scripts and executable manifest into current Cloudflare build/release/publication. Keep platform binaries outside Worker vendor maps.
acceptance: Native supported-host binaries/notices/dist metadata ship through owning manifest; P09.2 must prove actual installed launch, no user compiler.

tasks.title: Fulfil accepted validation route or record declined join
actions: Read the owning HTTP adoption decision. If accepted, wait for V08.4 and integrate its actual assembled entry/module propagation; if declined, record an evidenced no-op and the default 501 gap.
acceptance: Accepted delivery integration completes after V08.4 and its own module checks; subsequent V08.5 proves deployment, required by V08.6 before accepted outcome completion. A declined branch changes no route and never certifies deployed adoption.

tasks.title: Publish observer schema, workloads and budget procedure
actions: Create deterministic current-TS observers, raw-output/environment/resource schema and oracle/seed rules. Freeze selection and budget procedure before viewing Rust comparisons; measure current/prepared TS and complete consumers.
acceptance: Early actual TS observations are executable; getters/callbacks and side-effectful calls are never shadow-run twice; provisional speed cutoffs remain explicitly ratified/replaced before comparisons.

tasks.title: Common conformance and measurement harness ready
actions: Review cited raw evidence before releasing the gate.
acceptance: Subsystem observers add real adapter/distribution cases later; unit/native timings do not certify adoption.

tasks.title: All caller inventories and scope records reviewed
actions: Review cited raw evidence before releasing the gate.
acceptance: Every migrated path has an owner, admitted-input contract, real consumer and explicit retained/deferred scope.

tasks.title: All matching prepared TS boundaries reviewed
actions: Review cited raw evidence before releasing the gate.
acceptance: Zero unexplained prepared/current TS observable differences; extraction never collapses differing policies.

tasks.title: All actual binding and protocol contracts reviewed
actions: Review cited raw evidence before releasing the gate.
acceptance: Version, presence, lifetime, corruption and binding/native negative evidence is complete for each selected profile.

tasks.title: All declared distribution and consumer assets reviewed
actions: Review cited raw evidence before releasing the gate.
acceptance: Generated package-specific glue, actual consumers and supported installed hosts pass; declined validation route retains its visible adoption gap.

tasks.title: All parity, budget and rollout evidence reviewed
actions: Review cited raw evidence before releasing the gate.
acceptance: No unexplained observable differences; actual complete-call/native-reuse adoption and resource decisions retain raw evidence.

notes: All Cxx dependencies name readiness or exact handoff gates; Cxx.complete are aggregate outcomes only.
C04-delivery tasks can be ready together but run serially under one writer; no artificial cross-subsystem dependency is needed merely to serialize shared files.
Conditional accepted HTTP scope adds V08.4; declining leaves optional boxes unchecked and default deployment adoption blocked.
